issues.description: Field mismatch for Animal.name: the problem statement UML declares the Animal attribute 'name' as type String, while the solution implementation declares a private field of type StringBuilder. This diverges from the UML/specification and may confuse students about the expected attribute type and how getName()/setName() should be implemented.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML by changing the Animal class field to a String (e.g. private String name;), update the constructor to assign this.name = name;, and keep the public getName():String and setName(String) methods. Alternatively, if an internal StringBuilder is intentionally preferred, update the problem statement/UML to indicate that the internal representation may use StringBuilder so students are not required to use a plain String.
